## Triage: **P0** · `security` · `target:v18` · `area:access` · `domain:cli` · `pm:queue` · body redacted · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T15:56Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. ⚠️ This comment carries no reproduction.

- **Redacted in this act.** This card's "What happens" section and one line of the source report (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2129, comment `6251288276`, its `out_of_scope_findings` entry) carried a reproduction for an authorization hole. The maintainer's disclosure ruling (2026-08-18, objectstack-ai/objectstack#9387) forbids that anywhere on GitHub.
  - Existence and code positions stay published. The recipe is withheld, pending the maintainer.
  - Earlier revisions remain in both edit histories, and only a repository admin can delete them. That is on the maintainer's list.
- **Why P0:** a caller with no administrative right was measured to switch off an app's declared business controls on a write. It is the shape of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22310 (p0): a caller-chosen flag that removes the controls. It is in published packages (`18.0.0-next.3`), so every deployment that grants import is exposed.
- **Lane: `domain:cli`.** The flag is read at the door, in `packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts`. The fix is the door's gate on who may opt out, refused loudly for anyone else, as the card's "Expected" says. If the gate belongs in `packages/core`'s import runner instead, the lane says so and carries it under the cross-domain exception for a P0.
- **The adjacent flag** is measured and decided in the same round.
- **Release:** the fix should ride the next cut (#24168), which already waits on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24316's reach reading.

If the gate belongs in `packages/core`'s import runner instead, the lane says so and carries it under the cross-domain exception for a P0." · "The adjacent flag is measured and decided in the same round."). Disclosure: the maintainer's ruling of 2026-08-18 on objectstack-ai/objectstack#9387 holds. No reproduction goes into the PR body, a report or a comment; code positions and the fix's behaviour are published, and tests pin the fixed behaviour.
File surface (read on `origin/main` `c4526a705`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts` (the flag is read from the body at about `:296`): the opt-out is honoured only for a caller the platform already entitles to bypass an app's business controls, and every other caller is refused loudly (`403` with a stable code) before any row is written. The second body flag read the same way in that file is measured in the same round and gets the same gate if it removes a declared control.
- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts` (about `:758`, `skipAutomations: !runAutomations`) only if the gate must live there, for example because another door reaches the runner with a caller-chosen opt-out. That would be `domain:engine`'s file, carried under the P0 cross-domain exception and declared on objectstack-ai/objectstack#6367 in the act that finds it.
- `packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`, the `runAutomations` `.describe` text only (about `:287`). It says "a caller that wants a silent bulk load sends `runAutomations: false`", which this change makes false for an unentitled caller, so it is fixed here. `content/docs/references/api/export.mdx` is regenerated by the repo's generator, never by hand. This is `domain:spec`'s surface, carried under the P0 cross-domain exception and declared on objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017 in this act.
- Tests: an unentitled caller is refused on the opt-out, an entitled caller keeps it, and the default (automations run) is unchanged. The card's measured legs (an approval flow, and a freeze hook that `PATCH` already refuses) are pinned as behaviour without a recipe.
- A `patch` changeset per published package touched.
- ⛔ Hold-offs: no new permission key or capability name (the entitlement predicate is an existing one; see the dispatch); no release act (triage names the next cut, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168, which is not this seat's); `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**`.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` for the build. Ceiling: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for one review before the queue, reason taken from this act's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` output: "A card that only NARROWS one is `Clause-②: no`, stays in its lane, and owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue".
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Basis for the Clause-② line: a narrowing. The import door stops accepting an opt-out from an unentitled caller, and nothing newly accepted or exported is added. Amended 2026-10-18T18:26Z to carry the narrowing arm, as the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review `6253498392` on PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24379 required.
Responsibility: the REST import door reads the opt-out straight from the request body (`packages/rest`, this lane's) | none: the route's only gate is `enforceApiAccess` on the object's enable flags, and nothing checks who may opt out | any user who may import, on every deployment that grants it; measured by objectstack-ai/hotcrm's dev on `18.0.0-next.3` (detail withheld under the disclosure ruling)

Serial constraints cleared:
- Open PRs' file lists were read in this act: none touches `import-prepare.ts`, `import-runner.ts` or `export.zod.ts`.
- No open `pm:dispatched` claim names them.
- P0 dispatch above the seat's `batch` 2, as the P0 rule allows. This seat's in-flight work is disjoint: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23217 slice 4 (`service-storage`, core's ledger test, the runtime conformance test) and objectstack-ai/objectstack#24327 (`packages/runtime/src/domains/*` copy, `docs/qa` checklist).
